customer_message.subject: Help contesting lease termination, Feldstrasse 43, Zug
customer_message.body: Hello, I am writing through the online form to ask for help contesting the termination of my lease for the 3.5-room flat at Feldstrasse 43 in Zug. The landlord, Hausverwaltung Aare AG, sent me a written notice of termination. I have received the notice in writing and I want to challenge it. My spouse lives in the flat with me, and it is our family home. I believe the termination is retaliation. Shortly before the notice, I asserted my tenancy rights against the landlord: I complained about defects in the flat and I challenged the rent. The timing makes me think the notice is a response to those complaints rather than a genuine reason. I would like to know what steps I can take to contest the termination, which deadlines apply, and whether your insurance covers a review of the notice and representation in the conciliation procedure. Please tell me what documents you need from me. I can provide copies of my complaint letters and the notice itself. Thank you for your help. Taylor Brooks
